SELECT SUM(
        3959 * acos(
            sin(s1."Latitude" * 3.141592653589793 / 180) *
            sin(s2."Latitude" * 3.141592653589793 / 180) +
            cos(s1."Latitude" * 3.141592653589793 / 180) *
            cos(s2."Latitude" * 3.141592653589793 / 180) *
            cos((s2."Longitude" - s1."Longitude") * 3.141592653589793 / 180)
        )
    ) AS total_miles
FROM schools s1
JOIN schools s2 ON s1.CDSCode < s2.CDSCode
WHERE s1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND s2.County = 'Alameda'
  AND s1.SOC = '66'
  AND s2.SOC = '66';
